note: Gateway endpoints are not reachable from on premises; interface endpoint for S3 is. Direct Connect public VIF would also reach S3 but gives public IPs, which the stem excludes.
MACsec is only available on 10/100/400 Gbps dedicated connections, not 1 Gbps; so VPN over Direct Connect (public or transit VIF) is the answer.
Gateway endpoint (free) for VPC, interface endpoint for on-premises over VPN. Option A (advertising a gateway endpoint prefix list) does not work.
aws:sourceVpce deny in bucket policy. Option C (endpoint policy) restricts the endpoint, not the bucket.
Private VIF for VPC, public VIF for S3 (public IPs). No option offers an interface endpoint approach.
